body.Title: Candidate submits credential document packet
body.Description: Full packet: AL State License; AL Controlled Substances; current certifications; DEA; NPI# + notification letter + password; board certificate or eligibility letter; ECFMG certificate (international MDs); medical school diploma; USMLE CK & CS scores; graduate/medical school transcripts; proof of ID; CV; training certificates + residency/internship letters; case list (10-15 cases); Social Security card copy (MSO); passport-sized photo. Files go to Onboarding Documents Restricted.
